objective: Thread NoiseTruth from inject_noise through prepare_silver -> reconstruct_from_silver and wire __truth_id-aware metric functions so the six formerly-NULL feature metrics compute and land in Postgres on the synthetic path.

files_changed.summary: Added segmentation_prf1 (seg_precision/recall/f1 keys matching _PERSISTED_METRICS), deviation_prf1 (NoiseTruth.jumped_ids scorer), and a shared _bucket_by_icao helper. Overloaded position_rmse_m to join on __truth_id when truth is a NoiseTruth (legacy (icao24,time) path retained for existing tests). Overloaded coverage_ratio the same way: unique __truth_id / len(original_ids). Extended boundary_time_error_s to matched-per-icao24 semantics with tolerance_s and None-on-no-match. TYPE_CHECKING-only import of NoiseTruth; runtime isinstance via local import to avoid a circular through etl4.evaluate.

prepare_silver now returns (silver, rejected, noise_truth | None). reconstruct_from_silver accepts noise_truth=None and synthesises a NoiseTruth proxy from truth+silver when absent (N0, or a caller that does not thread it through); from_proxy gates off deviation_prf1 so synthesised zeros never land in the rec dict. Wired position_rmse_m, segmentation_prf1, boundary_time_error_s, coverage_ratio onto the rec dict for source=='synthetic'. GT keys are only inserted when non-None, so run_matrix._record and the sink's _as_float render NULL rather than tripping on round(None,digits). run_experiment composer: when truth is None and source == synthetic and __truth_id is on bronze, retain the pre-inject project_raw frame as truth_df (drop_duplicates on __truth_id); satisfies required-work A sentence 2 for the run_pipeline / direct pytest paths that don't pass --truth.

prepare_silver returns 3-tuple; pass 1 caches noise_truth per noise in a dict (synthetic only, so real-source frozensets of millions of ids don't need to pickle). Task tuple grows to 7 elements with noise_truth as the seventh; _worker forwards it to reconstruct_from_silver. Frozen dataclass pickles through ProcessPool in memory (does not violate the ADR's 'no disk persistence' clause). _record uses a None-safe _r helper for rmse_m / seg_f1 / coverage CSV columns so real-data runs do not crash.

commands_run.cmd: conda run -n opensky python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('etl4/bench/run_experiment.py').read()); ast.parse(open('etl4/evaluate/metrics.py').read()); ast.parse(open('etl4/bench/run_matrix.py').read()); print('syntax OK')"
conda run -n opensky python -c "from etl4.evaluate.metrics import segmentation_prf1, position_rmse_m, coverage_ratio, deviation_prf1, boundary_time_error_s; print('IMPORT OK')"

conda run -n opensky python etl4/bench/run_matrix.py --bronze data/bronze/t003_cell --truth data/reference/synthetic_truth/t003_cell.parquet --source synthetic --profiles N1 --methods time_gap --workers 1

conda run -n opensky python etl4/bench/run_matrix.py --bronze data/bronze/t003_cell --truth data/reference/synthetic_truth/t003_cell.parquet --source synthetic --profiles N0 N1 --methods time_gap kinematic kinematic_smoothing --workers 2

docker exec etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 -c "SELECT metric, value FROM eval_results WHERE run_id = (SELECT max(run_id) FROM pipeline_runs WHERE source='synthetic') AND metric IN ('position_rmse_m', 'seg_f1', 'seg_precision', 'seg_recall', 'coverage_ratio', 'boundary_err_s');"
